# RunningHub capability catalogue

Source: https://github.com/HM-RunningHub/OpenClaw_RH_Skills
Revision: 21ade9836e1e68bdb45fac9956b919f50901b8d4
Catalogue version: 2026-08-18, 420 endpoints.
License: Apache-2.0 (included).

The catalogue is retained unchanged. The workbench independently adapts the documented Chinese-site HTTP contracts into authenticated server routes, Chinese forms and durable task/result storage. It does not execute OpenClaw Python scripts, install an OpenClaw agent, copy persona instructions, or store plaintext keys in OpenClaw configuration. Model availability, permissions, and fees are determined by RunningHub when called, not guaranteed by this catalogue snapshot.
